svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.28 STUCCO
Stucco lath is held not less than 6 mm (¼″)
away from the backing by means of suitable
The Article names no device type or spacing, so devices are schematic. The backing is drawn as sheathing with a membrane.
